title: The Sabbath and the Willing Offering
reflectionText: Moses speaks of a holy day of rest before naming the offering and the work to be done. Gold and spices, cloth and wood, garments and vessels all appear in his instructions. What do you notice as you hear the Sabbath command beside the invitation to a willing heart?
